scripts.check: npm run build && node --check app.js && node --check worker.js && node --check scripts/build.mjs && node --check scripts/wrangler-env.mjs && node scripts/wrangler-env-test.mjs && node scripts/worker-test.mjs && npm run smoke
scripts.deploy: npm run build && node scripts/wrangler-env.mjs deploy
scripts.deploy:dry-run: npm run build && node scripts/wrangler-env.mjs deploy --dry-run
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build && node scripts/wrangler-env.mjs dev
scripts.leads:summary: wrangler d1 execute inas-lp-leads --remote --command "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'new' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS new_count, MAX(created_at) AS latest_at FROM leads"
scripts.leads:list: wrangler d1 execute inas-lp-leads --remote --command "SELECT submission_id, role, scale, pain, email, message, audience, attribution_json, created_at, status FROM leads ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100"
